examples.text: Many children collect things, but few have enough money to buy the things they really want, and they lose interest.
examples.translation: 许多孩子会收集东西，但很少有人有足够的钱买下真正想要的东西，因此他们逐渐失去了兴趣。
examples.speechText: Many children collect things, but few have enough money to buy the things they really want, and they lose interest.

examples.text: His aim was to restore pride in being black and to inspire black Americans to campaign for equal rights.
examples.translation: 他的目标是让黑人重新以自己的身份为荣，并激励美国黑人为争取平等权利而努力。
examples.speechText: His aim was to restore pride in being black and to inspire black Americans to campaign for equal rights.

examples.text: She spoke once of never really having a mother.
examples.translation: 她曾说过，自己仿佛从未真正拥有过母亲。
examples.speechText: She spoke once of never really having a mother.

examples.text: Instead, it comes from internal thoughts（thought的复数形式） and assumptions.
examples.translation: 相反，它源于内心的想法和假设。
examples.speechText: Instead, it comes from internal thoughts and assumptions.

examples.text: Minimalism goes against consumer society by dramatically reducing possessions（possession的复数形式）.
examples.translation: 极简主义通过大幅减少个人物品，来对抗消费主义社会的观念。
examples.speechText: Minimalism goes against consumer society by dramatically reducing possessions.

examples.text: You should jump softly and low to the ground, and keep your hands low and close to your body.
examples.translation: 你应该轻柔地、低着身子跳到地面，同时将双手低垂并贴近身体。
examples.speechText: You should jump softly and low to the ground, and keep your hands low and close to your body.

examples.text: When humpbacks live in denser populations, males looking for mates also have to deal with competing whales.
examples.translation: 当座头鲸生活在种群密度更高的环境中时，寻找配偶的雄性座头鲸还必须应对其他竞争的鲸鱼。
examples.speechText: When humpbacks live in denser populations, males looking for mates also have to deal with competing whales.

examples.text: Indeed, the health benefits of jumping rope are many and affect multiple systems（system的复数形式） throughout the body.
examples.translation: 确实，跳绳对健康有许多好处，并会影响全身多个系统。
examples.speechText: Indeed, the health benefits of jumping rope are many and affect multiple systems throughout the body.

examples.text: When you picture a desert, you probably imagine a vast, empty landscape far from any water.
examples.translation: 当你想象沙漠时，你大概会想象一片辽阔而荒芜的景象，远离任何水源。
examples.speechText: When you picture a desert, you probably imagine a vast, empty landscape far from any water.

examples.text: My brother likes eating very much but he isn't very particular about the food he eats.
examples.translation: 我哥哥很喜欢吃东西，但对吃什么并不十分挑剔。
examples.speechText: My brother likes eating very much but he isn't very particular about the food he eats.

examples.text: That number is near estimated pre-whaling levels.
examples.translation: 这一数量接近人们估计的大规模捕鲸活动开始前的水平。
examples.speechText: That number is near estimated pre-whaling levels.

examples.text: Over the years, people have made up new languages with this aim.
examples.translation: 多年来，人们出于这个目的创造了一些新语言。
examples.speechText: Over the years, people have made up new languages with this aim.

examples.text: Their genes（gene的复数形式） passed to future generations.
examples.translation: 它们的基因传给了后代。
examples.speechText: Their genes passed to future generations.

examples.text: She is well-known in her lifetime and is still regarded as a great poet now.
examples.translation: 她一生都广为人知，至今仍被视为伟大的诗人。
examples.speechText: She is well-known in her lifetime and is still regarded as a great poet now.
